quests.title: The Last Voyage Home

find.text: A broken ship's ribs, and in the sand a dead sailor with a rune-tablet clutched in both hands: 'Ice cracks under the long halls. The captain's ship sleeps in the howe. Wake her before the thaw.'

quests.desc: A sailor's skeleton at a landing of broken ships holds a rune-tablet: the ice will crack and a ship sleeps in a howe.
quests.pitch: The old hold at Kjolvik keeps hearing the ice speak at night.

objectives.text: Take the captain's last page to the hold at Kjolvik.
Persuade the elders of Kjolvik and take the hold-token to the dragon mound.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The tablet's trail passes a shield-fort and the last long halls to a frozen dragon and a buried ship.

quests.title: The Last Voyage Home (II)
quests.desc: The tablet's trail passes a shield-fort and the last long halls to a frozen dragon and a buried ship.
quests.pitch: The old hold at Kjolvik keeps hearing the ice speak at night.

objectives.text: Bind the dragon's thaw with the cold shard and go on to the howe.
Speak the forgotten word before the wolf-jarl's ship and set her free.

quests.outro: The great ship shook the barrow's snow from her ribs and rose. Her ropes were rotten, her mast a frozen pole, but the hold's people climbed aboard, one by one, with their ancestors' shields.

quests.title: The Four-Court Seal

find.text: A watch-tower's border stone carries a fourfold seal, three quarters worn smooth. On the fourth, a handful of Akaviri characters: 'Three bow. One waits in the ice.'

quests.desc: A watch-tower's border stone carries a fourfold seal, three quarters worn smooth.
quests.pitch: The watchmen at Tang Mo say the border stone has been rubbed away by pilgrims who pay no coin.

objectives.text: Take the harbour's quarter from the dragon-prow and cross to the mountain village.
Take the lantern's quarter and climb to the serpent temple.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The seal's quarters are held across a harbour village, a mountain village and a serpent temple, ending at a valley of ribs and an ice throne.

quests.title: The Four-Court Seal (II)
quests.desc: The seal's quarters are held across a harbour village, a mountain village and a serpent temple, ending at a valley of ribs and an ice throne.
quests.pitch: The watchmen at Tang Mo say the border stone has been rubbed away by pilgrims who pay no coin.

objectives.text: Barter or take the third quarter from the serpent temple.
Cross the valley of ribs with the three quarters and find the ice throne.
Join the four quarters on the throne and decide whether the valley stays shut.

quests.outro: I laid the fourth quarter against the other three and the valley of ribs, which had been groaning for a thousand years, fell quiet. The serpent-court will come, but not through that door.

quests.title: The Walking Reef

find.text: A pen-keeper's totem is hung with pink coral-shards that have started to take root in the wood. A scratch on its post: 'The pens are eating it. The pens are growing. Who feeds the pens?'

quests.desc: A pen-keeper's totem sprouting pink coral, with a note that the pens are growing strangely.
quests.pitch: The pen-keepers say the serpents have been eating something pink, and it has not agreed with them.

objectives.text: Take the admiral's chart from the flagship and sail for the plague-coral sea.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The reef's walk leads past the shell-raft fleet and the coral tower of Thras to the sea-serpent citadel's window on the deep.

quests.title: The Walking Reef (II)
quests.desc: The reef's walk leads past the shell-raft fleet and the coral tower of Thras to the sea-serpent citadel's window on the deep.
quests.pitch: The pen-keepers say the serpents have been eating something pink, and it has not agreed with them.

objectives.text: Reach the heart-chamber of the coral tower and take the seed.
Close the sea-gate against the reef and counsel the sleepless king.

quests.outro: At the citadel's window, the reef's great pink head lay pressed to the glass. I closed the sea-gate against it. For a week the fleet slept. Then, far below, the head turned, patient, to wait for the next tide.

quests.title: The Last Lesson

find.text: A training-post is carved with four forms. Three have a student's name. The fourth reads only: 'The Last Lesson, taught on the water.' A master's sandal sits on the step.

quests.desc: A training-post carved with four forms, the fourth to be taught on the water.
quests.pitch: A veteran at the Ra Gada camp says the fourth form has not been taught in living memory.

objectives.text: Earn the second form's stone at the sunken dojo and go on to the serpent temple.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The lesson's next forms are in a sunken dojo and a serpent temple, and the last in a sunken temple of kings.

quests.title: The Last Lesson (II)
quests.desc: The lesson's next forms are in a sunken dojo and a serpent temple, and the last in a sunken temple of kings.
quests.pitch: A veteran at the Ra Gada camp says the fourth form has not been taught in living memory.

objectives.text: Dance the third form on the scales and bring the token to the sunken temple.
Row the funeral barge out through the sea-gate and finish the Last Lesson.

quests.outro: I rowed the funeral barge out of the sunken temple's flooded hall and through a gate of light. The kings did not speak. I think they were satisfied that someone, finally, had finished the lesson.
